_note: Margin applied to what GSF charges us, to get the price a customer sees. Edit this file to change a rate; the server picks up changes without a restart.
_units: Percent ADDED to cost. 58.2 means a 10.00 part is quoted at 15.82. Not a share of the sell price.
_matching: Keys are GSF category names, lowercased, exactly as data/categories.json spells them. Find one with: node bin/gsf.js categories <search>. Anything not listed here uses defaultPercent.
